must.why: No video was produced, only face crops and a question.

must.item: Male face matches man portrait, female matches woman portrait

faults.what: No swapped video delivered. The task stopped at a clarification question.

The assistant said it could not view the crops, then asked the user to classify the faces. The crops are plainly a man (A), a bearded man (B), a woman (C) and a profile of the first man (D). The agent could have resolved this itself.

The clip has three people (two men, one woman), but the assistant's message does not say so. The user's premise of 'both people' is therefore ambiguous. This is a legitimate reason to ask, but the question was not framed clearly.

summary: The agent only ran face detection and asked the user which crops are the man and woman, so no face-swapped video was produced, even though the crops were easy to identify.
